messages:
ana_marketing: Quick ask for next week's webinar assets ":sparkles:" — need a small, re-usable pack for slides, social, and the registration page.
ana_marketing: Deliverables: hero static (1600x900) + 3s loop GIF, 3 micro-tiles (1080x1080, 1200x628, 320x480), a compact swimlane inbound routing diagram (1200x600), and a one-slide "method" visual for tweet thread. Include SVG + PNG exports and alt text notes.
cam_design: Got it. Two colorways (light/dark) and export size targets? Also, do we need a paid CTA variant?
ana_marketing: Yep light/dark. Keep PNGs <200KB if possible. Paid CTA variant for banners says "Register now"; organic banners say "Learn more."
ryan_growth: For routing diagram: form -> score -> premium | standard queue -> AE handoff. Unassigned after 48h -> SDR. Show CRM tag field "inference_use_case" but keep public labels generic.
jia_prod: JSON for routing if helpful: `{"lead_source":"webinar","score_threshold":80,"routing":"premium|standard|SDR"}`
morgan_legal: Quick legal flag: any comparative benchmark language needs review. Tag me on hero/comparative copy and I can respond within 24h.
asset-bot: Uploaded figma://inference-mini/1777770001 (preview https://figma-preview.example/1777770001) :white_check_mark:
cam_design: I'll drop initial comps by Tue 10:00 PT: hero (light/dark) + routing sketch first, then tiles and 1-slide method. Will add alt text suggestions in figma notes.
ana_marketing: Priority order: 1) hero GIF + static, 2) routing diagram, 3) micro-tiles, 4) method slide. Thanks team — tag me on uploads.
